For a 50-person Indian company, I’d shortlist these three:

MakeMyTrip myBiz — Best fit if you want a self-serve, India-first setup. Corporate fares, GST invoices, policy controls, expense reconciliation and dedicated support are built in. It supports SMEs as well as larger companies. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
+1

FCM Travel India — More genuinely managed/TMC-oriented. Stronger for approvals, traveller tracking, reporting, negotiated rates and 24/7 human support, with India-specific booking infrastructure. 
FCM Travel
+1

BCD Travel — Suited to a company expecting more complex or international travel. Offers end-to-end booking, programme management, payments, meetings/events and consulting. 
BCD Travel

Key difference: myBiz is primarily a scalable digital platform; FCM combines technology with hands-on TMC management; BCD is oriented toward sophisticated, globally managed programmes.

Pricing: these providers generally quote corporate accounts rather than publishing a fixed ₹/employee price, so request a per-booking/service-fee schedule and implementation costs before comparing.
